state_change_proposals: The 305th: camp on a shale step east of the Span's far rim; the hills with a square notch (the pass) ahead; the third-tier point a day or two beyond by the office's distance. Cash 123.

THE POINT FIXED: a thumbnail circle past the hills on the line, from two sources (the office's distance/bearing from a hold; the dead man's grade; the walls' lean) — Karis will pace it standing on it.

The Span's carvings: more rows than any floor; the rows LEAN along the bearing, east ('Whoever cut them knew where the next one was' / Vastin: 'Or where the last one was') — undecided which way is first.

KARIS'S FINDING (Book-9 plant c, stated): identical failure at every perimeter — the lamps line; 'spiritual entity' (the office's phrase) has no wire; filed as unexplained. THE REFUSAL: Vastin's sentence stopped by the ruler line; two pages, no line; Cael logged the not-drawing and did not lay his own deep-layer count beside them ('three things not done at one fire'). Vastin: 'Noted' (third).

THE CRACK: a directive at the file's head (six years back; the office's ruling hand; 'Findings under the fifth column to be held. Not for onward transmission. Not for citation. Not for the seat.'; a seal) with a filed OBJECTION on its back in a second hand and a second seal ('the holding of a finding is not the finding's disproof. Refer to the seat.'). Vastin's crack line verbatim; he could name two seals and did not. Karis: 'recent administration' = the Compact; Vastin: 'Yes. Part of it.'

Two sticks at the fire (Vastin's second cut for the broad man). The broad man said 'Aye' to Oryn (his first word to the six). The healers' THIRD exchange: the other bound Oryn's work at her leave. Oryn to Teague: 'Lead from the front of it with the other hand.' / 'Noted.' / 'I'm going to have to find another word.'

SELN on the pass: 'a place I'd put seven people if I had seven and knew twelve were coming … They learned the barricade.' The watch went up onto the ground ahead. Count at every halt: twelve and a mule, nothing behind or beside.
Close: the fixed dialogue over the map; 'as old as the Architect' (the record's title) spoken by Karis.
